颂赞日之荣耀，使你获得 %d 精神豁免，并增加 %0.1f%% 最大生命值（当前加成：%d）。
		同时只能激活一种赞歌。

entries.source: Lean, mean, and shaggy, it stares at you with hungry eyes.
entries.target: 它精瘦、凶悍、皮毛蓬松，正用饥饿的眼神盯着你。
通用 增加火焰伤害

		This cannot trigger more than once per turn.
		The damage will scale with your Physical Power.
entries.target:
装填燃烧弹，使你的攻击额外造成 %d%% 武器伤害的火焰伤害，作用于以目标为中心、半径 %d 的范围内。

		伤害受物理强度加成。

entries.source: Deep in the Dreadfell you fought and destroyed the Master, a powerful vampire.
entries.target: 在恐惧王座深处你与领主——一个强大的吸血鬼——战斗并消灭了他。

entries.source:
You see a mural showing a huge metropolis made of crystal, with small islands of stone floating in the air behind it. In the foreground is sitting a Sher'Tul, with a hand stretched up to the sky.
There is some text beneath
entries.target:
你在壁画上看到一个巨大的水晶之城，有数个浮空岛悬浮在周围。在画面的最前端坐着的是夏·图尔人，他向天空笔直的举起手臂。
下面有一行文字

entries.source: The Doomed strike from behind a veil of darkness or a host of shadows.
entries.target: 末日使者操纵阴影，从黑暗中发动攻击。

entries.source:
Your fungus reaches into the primordial ages of the world, granting you ancient instincts.
		Each time you receive non-regeneration healing you gain %0.1f%% of a turn per 100 life healed.  This effect can't add energy past 2 stored turns and overhealing is not counted.
		Also, regeneration effects on you will decrease your equilibrium by %0.1f each turn.
		The turn gain increases with your Mindpower.
entries.target:
你的孢子可以追溯到创世纪元，你可以传承来自远古的天赋。
		每当你获得一个非回复的治疗效果，每治疗 100 点生命值，你获得 %0.1f%% 个回合。
		这一效果最多获得 2 个回合。
		同时，每当你受到回复作用时，每回合你的失衡值将会减少 %0.1f。
		增益回合受精神强度加成。

entries.source: If you lose more than this percentage of life in a turn, a warning will display and all key/mouse input will be ignored for 2 seconds to prevent mistakes.#WHITE#
entries.target: 当你在一回合内损失了超过该百分比的生命时，将弹出提醒并暂时关闭鼠标、键盘操作2秒。#WHITE#

entries.source: Engaged in a grapple draining %d stamina per turn and redirecting %d%% of damage taken to %s.  Any movement will break the effect as will some unarmed talents.
entries.target: 目标进入抓取状态，每回合吸取 %d 体力，同时将 %d%% 伤害转移到 %s。任何移动或其他一些徒手技能都会取消这个状态。

entries.source: Your Rogue's Brew fortifies you for 8 turns, preventing you from dying until you reach -%d life.
entries.target: 你的盗贼佳酿会强化你 8 回合，使你在生命值降至 -%d 之前不会死亡。

entries.source: Grappling techniques that may not be practiced in massive armor or while a weapon or shield is equipped.
entries.target: 抓取敌人的技巧，你不能装备板甲、武器和盾牌。

entries.source: @Target@ walks on a trap, and there is a loud noise.
entries.target: @Target@踩上陷阱，发出了巨大的声音。

entries.source: Adjust your Rogue's Brew formulation so that it fortifies you for 8 turns, preventing you from dying until you reach -%d life.
entries.target: 调整盗贼佳酿的配方，使其强化你 8 回合；在此期间，你的生命值降至 -%d 之前不会死亡。

entries.source: Made from the bones of many creatures, this staff glows with power. You can feel its evil presence even from a distance.
entries.target: 这根法杖由许多生物的骨头制成并散发着能量。你甚至可以在很远的地方感受到它的邪恶气息。

entries.source:
Each time you take damage, you roll %d%% of your mental save against it.  A successful saving throw can crit and will reduce the damage by at least 50%%.
		The first talent point invested will also increase the amount of Psi you gain from Willpower by 0.5, but reduce the amount of life you gain from Constitution by 0.25.
		The first talent point also increases your solipsism threshold by 10%% (currently %d%%).
entries.target:
每当你受到伤害时，你会使用 %d%% 精神豁免来鉴定。鉴定时精神豁免可能暴击，至少减少 50%% 的伤害。
		学习此技能时，（高于基础值 10 的）每点意志会额外增加 0.5 点灵能值上限，而（高于基础值 10 的）每点体质会减少 0.25 点生命上限（若低于基础值 10 则增加生命上限）。
		学习此技能也会增加你 10 %%唯我临界点（当前 %d%%）。

entries.source: A choker made of pure flame, casting forever shifting patterns around the neck of its wearer. Its fire seems to not harm the wearer.
entries.target: 一个由火焰形成的护符，在佩戴者的颈部周围投射出不断变幻的光影。它的火焰似乎不会伤害到佩戴者。

entries.source: Angolwen, the hidden city of magic
entries.target: 安格利文，隐藏的魔法之城

You manipulate the spacetime continuum in such a way that you switch places with another creature with in a range of %d.  The targeted creature will be confused (power %d%%) for %d turns.
		The spell's hit chance will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
你控制时间的流动来使你和 %d 码范围内的某个怪物交换位置。目标会混乱（%d%% 强度）%d 回合。
		法术命中率受法术强度加成。

entries.source: The target is in despair, reducing their armour, defence, mindsave and mind resist by %d.
entries.target: 目标陷入绝望，护甲，闪避，精神豁免和精神抗性降低 %d。

entries.source: #OLIVE_DRAB#Your premonition allows you to raise a shield just in time!
entries.target: #OLIVE_DRAB#你的预知能力让你及时升起一道护盾！

entries.source:
This is my Ring of Blood! Listen, you have now two choices.
Since you do not look like slave fodder to me I will offer to let you pay to play the game.
If you feel you cannot take part in a slaver's game, I am afraid you will need to... disappear.
entries.target:
这里是鲜血之环！听着，你现在有两个选择。
既然你看起来不像是当奴隶的料，我可以让你付费参加这个游戏。
要是你不愿参加奴隶贩子的游戏，恐怕你就得……消失了。

#{italic}#...The feather flies gently in the wind.
The tree's roots run deep...#{normal}#
entries.target:
这里有一段铭文：
#{italic}#……羽毛在风中轻盈飘飞。
树根深深扎下……#{normal}#

entries.source: A small rock that seems from beyond this world, vibrating with a fierce energy.  It feels warped and terrible and evil... and yet oh so powerful.
entries.target: 这块小石头看起来不是这个世界的，它不时产生着激烈的能量震动，让人感到扭曲、可怕、邪恶……而又强大的能量。

entries.source: Use energy to move yourself and others.
entries.target: 使用能量来移动你自己和他人。

entries.source: There seems to be a total of four of them. The more you have the weaker the shield will be.
entries.target: 似乎一共有四个水晶球，你得到的越多，护盾的防御力越弱。

entries.source: A paper scrap containing some lore.
entries.target: 包含了一些手札的纸片。

entries.source: and devoured alongside a Sun Paladin
entries.target: 并和那位太阳骑士一起葬身蛛腹

entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了黑暗之心并杀死了沉梦者。#WHITE#

entries.source:
Dear Rolf,

I hope this letter finds you well. I must apologise for this recent dry spell in our communication; my adventures across Maj'Eyal have taken many exciting and perilous turns as of late. What turns do I speak of, you ask? I know how you delight in reading the accounts of my exploits, so I shall waste no further time on this pre-amble.

Imagine, if you will, a wolf. Imagine a beastly wolf, a wolf with strength, ferocity and a lust for flesh matching that of an entire pack of its lesser kind. You too may have some small experience with these "wargs" as the locals are wont to call them. Now... imagine one the size of a bear. Truly, as I travelled the lands surrounding Derth did I come across such a monstrous, awe-inspiring, lupine adversary. With fangs of a length to match my own blade, I entered combat against this lupine lord and its skulking brood. To my regret I failed in slaying the beast, but I assure you - simply surviving against such feral rage is an honour worthy of recognition and renown.

And indeed, would there have been much glory in killing such a creature? True, I would have had enough to fur to line each and every boot and hat in Derth, but legends must live on. They are what give this world its very spirit!

With eager anticipation for your reply,
Weisman
entries.target:
亲爱的罗尔夫，

我希望这封信可以安全的到达你手。我必须为我们最近这段时间疏于联系道歉：最近，我在马基·埃亚尔各地的冒险经历又有了许多惊险刺激的转折。你问我说的是什么转折？我知道你很喜欢阅读我的冒险事迹，所以客套话我就不多说了。

想像一下，一只庞大如熊的饿狼，赤眼如炙，饥渴的吞噬着它周围一切的生命。这只暴君所带来的威胁远超一整群它弱小的同类。你也许亦曾对付一些当地人口中所谓的座狼，但想象一下这只如同熊一般巨大的“好家伙”。事实上，当我在周围的旅行时，不巧就遭遇到了这样一只令人生畏的贪婪怪物，它挥舞的獠牙比我的剑还要长。于是我与这只座狼王和它的狼子狼孙们展开了激烈的搏斗。可惜的是我最终并没有杀死这只野兽，但我能自豪的说，能从这场战斗中存活就已经是值得称道的了。

再说，杀死这样的生物又能有多大荣耀呢？对，我确实会得到一大堆狼毛，多到足以给德斯镇每双靴子和每顶帽子做毛皮衬里，但我的内心告诉自己这种传说中的生物必须让其繁衍下去。因为正是它们，赋予了这个世界真正的灵魂！

殷切的期盼着你的回信，
威斯曼

entries.source: The target is infected by a disease, reducing its dexterity by %d and doing %0.2f blight damage per turn.
entries.target: 目标被感染疾病，降低 %d 敏捷并每回合受到 %0.2f 枯萎伤害。

entries.source:
Sorcerers? I have never heard of them. There were rumours about a new master of the Pride, but it seems they have two.
Thank you for everything. You must continue your hunt now that you know what to look for.
entries.target:
法师？我从来没听说过他们。传说部落有了一个新的领袖，看样子现在应该有两个。
感谢你所做的一切。既然你已经知道要找的是什么，就必须继续你的追猎。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You can feel the man smiling from inside his hood*#WHITE#
The Arena is where the brave come to fight against all odds.
We are still growing up, and we lack challengers...
It's like a gamble, but you use your fighting instead of money to play, you see?
We in the Arena work hard to make a good show, and in return...you can get enough
wealth and glory to last for centuries!
If you can pass my little test...I will #LIGHT_RED#allow you to join the Arena when
you are done with your adventures.#WHITE#
You also shall gather some much needed #LIGHT_RED#combat experience#WHITE# from fighting
our men...so, what do you think? Are you up to it?
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你能感觉到兜帽下的男人露出了微笑*#WHITE#
竞技场是勇者迎战重重险境的地方。
我们仍在发展，正缺少挑战者……
这就像一场赌博，只不过你下注的不是金钱，而是自己的战斗本领，明白吗？
我们竞技场竭力奉上精彩表演；作为回报……你能赢得享用几个世纪也用不完的财富与荣耀！
如果你能通过我的小小考验……等你的冒险结束后，我会#LIGHT_RED#准许你加入竞技场。#WHITE#
与我的手下交战，还能让你获得急需的#LIGHT_RED#战斗经验#WHITE#……
怎么样？你能胜任吗？

		同时，躲闪效果和不可见带来的闪避效果会被取消。
		命中率受物理强度加成。

entries.source: This very thin sword cuts through the air with ease, allowing remarkably quick movement.
entries.target: 这柄超乎寻常的薄刃能轻松地在空气中挥舞，让你行动更为迅速。
